name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source billing and client management for hosting providers, with invoicing, orders, support tickets and a client area, backed by MariaDB.

alerts.message: Finish setup in the web installer: database host fossbilling-db, port 3306, database and user fossbilling, password = the DB_PASSWORD environment variable. Keep the URL as https://<your domain>/ and tick "Trust this reverse proxy configuration" so client IPs reach the rate limiter. The installer creates the first admin account.
